findings.statement: A short/long-distance and cyclic-clock equation improves completed-trip duration prediction in a reserved quarter against the frozen matched controls.
findings.applicability: Green-taxi2025 declared routine records, duration0–24h and distance0–1000km; known officialzones and source-month-consistent timestamps. Provider-reported records may contain errors; no congestion intervention, routing policy or achieved operational benefit.
findings.limitations: Recorded distance is post-trip; only one city/year is tested. Negative airport offset, high residual errors and provider quality limitations exclude a universal speed or operational dispatch claim.
findings.falsification: Recorded distance is post-trip; only one city/year is tested. Negative airport offset, high residual errors and provider quality limitations exclude a universal speed or operational dispatch claim.
